title: Slow down the audio in your Seedance 2.0 educational videos to help autistic…
content: Slow down the audio in your Seedance 2.0 educational videos to help autistic children and other learners process and understand the content more easily.
tips: Slow down the audio in your Seedance 2.0 educational videos to help autistic children and other learners process and understand the content more easily.

es.content: Reduce la velocidad del audio en tus videos educativos de Seedance 2.0 para ayudar a los niños autistas y a otros estudiantes a procesar y comprender el contenido con mayor facilidad.

fr.content: Ralentissez l’audio de vos vidéos éducatives Seedance 2.0 afin d’aider les enfants autistes et les autres apprenants à traiter et à comprendre le contenu plus facilement.

ja.content: Seedance 2.0 の教育動画では、音声をゆっくりにして、自閉症の子どもやその他の学習者が内容をより理解しやすくなるようにしましょう。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0 교육용 영상의 오디오 속도를 늦춰 자폐 아동과 다른 학습자들이 내용을 더 쉽게 처리하고 이해할 수 있도록 하세요.

pt.content: Desacelere o áudio em seus vídeos educacionais do Seedance 2.0 para ajudar crianças autistas e outros alunos a processar e entender o conteúdo com mais facilidade.

zh.content: 将 Seedance 2.0 教育视频中的音频放慢，帮助自闭症儿童和其他学习者更轻松地处理和理解内容。
